name: Univers-Cité des mathématiques

learning.course_authority: atlas/math_curriculum_registry.json; Moodle runtime materializes course spaces

integration_invariants: Canonical Math pathway identifiers use the math.path.* namespace.
The Math curriculum is concept-led and anchored in the declared source documents.
Structural mathematical claims must remain distinct from stronger metaphysical or ontological interpretations.
Former Math v1 pathway identifiers are resolved through explicit read-only split mappings; they are never written by new integrations.
New integrations must write canonical Math identifiers only.
Live media, permission and user state remain owned by Moodle and their existing plugins.
The mathematical library remains an autonomous fund; cross-library visibility requires explicit bridges.
